cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name is on bathroom duty, not mine. Take the mop by the handle, please; you're dripping on the clean floor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then follow my instructions. Start at the far corner, not the doorway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Show me the first bit and I'll carry on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Move your hands apart on the handle. Your hands, please. I can demonstrate perfectly well without taking it off you.
